facts.text: Serve the snacks when Ripley first walks into the mess hall and every prisoner stops eating.
facts.why: A dinner scene with Ripley at the prisoners' table is real (Dillon lets her sit). None of the pages read say every prisoner stops eating when she walks in.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Ripley first sits down to dinner with the prisoners.

facts.text: The EEV crashed in the shallows
facts.why: The pages read say the pod crash-lands on Fiorina 161 and the inmates recover it. Only the Assembly Cut has Ripley washing up on a shore. No page says shallows.

facts.text: pulled from the wreck on the beach, still in one piece
facts.why: Same gap as the wink: the pages read don't put the wreck on a beach.
facts.fix: recovered from the crashed pod, still in one piece

vibe.verdict: A dry, believable Fiorina breakroom with Dillon, Aaron and the furnace, but it leaves out the lead pour and Ripley's best lines.
missing: The molten lead finale in the foundry (Dillon, Morse and the Alien)
'You've been in my life so long I can't remember anything else' (Ripley)
Rumour control in the mess hall, when Andrews is dragged into the vent
Clemens and his prison barcode tattoo (the infirmary)
Spike the dog and the first chestburster (after the funeral)
ideas: Swap 'Leadworks molten hot chocolate' note for the lead pour: 'Poured slow, like the lead in the mould.'
Swap the 'UNSOLVED' stamp for 'RUMOUR CONTROL', from Andrews's mess hall briefing.
Swap Dillon's desk note for his real line: 'We recognize that we are poor sinners in the hands of an angry God.'
Swap 'Builder's tea' note for Morse's 'I hate bugs!' on the 85 joke.
